messages:
nico: Quick postmortem follow-upwe keep hitting the same three vendor classes: cloud control-plane surges, model-registry throttles, and auth refresh storms. Need owners + minimal sprint plan. Can folks claim?
alexa: I9ll take control-plane mitigations. Plan: client-side token-bucket + region failover + add short chaos test that injects 10% 5xx. Deliverables: runbook + test harness. ETA: 7 working days.
sam: I9ll own model-registry. Short-term: add prefetch warmers for hot models, implement read-only fallback (serve last-known-good), and a small client backpressure gate. Canary: 10% staging -> 10% prod -> evaluate 48h.
pri: I9ll do auth-provider work. Quick wins: jittered refresh, tiny in-process token cache (TTL ~100ms), and secondary-provider wiring. Blocking: need security to confirm KMS rotation window.
ops-bot: Created epic INF-12021: "vendor-dep-quickfixes" https://redwood.internal/INF-12021. Default due: 2028-10-01.
alexa: Adding fallback snippet to the epic:
```json
{"fallback_order": ["inproc-cache","registry-readonly","graceful-degrade"], "retries": {"attempts": 3, "backoff_ms": [150, 400, 900]}}
```
sam: Canary plan added in INF-12021: cron pre-warm at 03:00 UTC, staging ramp 10% for 4h, prod 10% for 48h then expand. I'll include memory/cost estimate.
pri: Vendor outreach: emailed auth-partner@vendor.example requesting burst policy, test token endpoint, and escalation contact. Pinged sec for KMS slot.
nico: Success metrics: aim for >=40% reduction in P99 spike rate per class and incident recurrence <=1/month within 45 days. Telemetry: sam + alexa add synthetic checks (5m cadence) and a dashboard card.
ops-bot: Reminder: INF-12021 has checklist items without estimates. Please add EOD.
alexa: I'll post the runbook skeleton and a 1-line rollback: immediate traffic cut + switch to registry-readonly + vendor escalation.
sam: Added a small chaos test script to the epic and a cost delta check (flag if >7%).
pri: Once sec confirms KMS slot I'll schedule a 15m sync to unblock vendor failover testing.
nico: Actions: add one-line subtasks in INF-12021 with owners + estimates by EOD, add runbook sections (indicators/rollback/contacts), and schedule monthly 15m drills for three months. Keep detailed discussion in the epic. :thumbsup:
